extension.name: Rail Safety Worker ID Card
extension.description: This extension enables the generation of rail safety worker identification cards. The process is similar to creating mailing labels. The output is a PDF file. An ID card includes a contact's photo and a QR code that contains a URL that links to a web page that displays rail safety approvals, assessments, training and health data. This is a stand-alone web page (but it is included in this extension) that retrieves data from CiviCRM's database.
extension.comments: Presently the page displayed from the QR code's URL is highly PRRPS-specific and will need to be modified.
